title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): video recap of recorded meetings in Copilot Chat
summary: Hold: the recording-permissions statement omits the exception for guests and external attendees, who need the recording explicitly shared with them. The page also says intelligent recap requires transcription even though a cited Microsoft page documents recap without it. The listed paths and commands are documented, but Microsoft pages disagree about whether the intelligent recap switch currently takes effect.

claims.where: controls[3].api and note; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false disables intelligent recap for all meetings covered by the policy, including meetings without saved transcripts.
claims.quote:
Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false
claims.fix: Keep the call and add to controls[3].note and the advice relying on it: 'The intelligent recap guidance documents this switch, but the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference says the feature is not fully released and the setting has no effect; test enforcement before relying on it.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy, whose -AllowIntelligentRecap section says 'This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.'

claims.claim: No Teams admin center path is documented for the policy switch that disables intelligent recap.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center turn off intelligent recap AllowIntelligentRecap Copilot and other AI. Read intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; the disable operation is PowerShell, while the documented UI is for document expiration.

claims.where: controls[4]; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no UI or API setting that disables video recap alone in Teams or Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Searched: video recap disable setting Teams Copilot Chat PowerShell Microsoft Graph policy; "video recap" "policy" "disable". Read intelligent-recap-calls-meetings, intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and searched Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy for VideoRecap; no separate switch.

claims.claim: Intelligent recap depends on transcription being enabled.
claims.quote: With this feature, an AI summary is generated even when recording and transcription aren't enabled.
claims.fix: Change controls[2].governs to 'Whether users can transcribe meetings, which video recap depends on'. Replace 'Transcription must be on for intelligent recap' in Scope with 'Video recap requires a recorded and transcribed meeting', as stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/intelligent-recap-calls-meetings. Apply the same control label in the rendered table.

claims.claim: Recording is required for the full intelligent recap experience.
claims.quote: For the full recap experience for meetings and events, you must assign a policy that allows recording for your users. If recording is turned off, users experience recap without the recording, speakers, topics, and chapters.

claims.claim: Both the meeting organiser and recording initiator need recording permission.
claims.quote: Both the organizer and recording initiator need to have recording permissions to record the meeting or event.

claims.claim: Transcription is a per-organiser and per-user policy setting that must be enabled for the organiser and recording or transcript initiator.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: New or updated policies are assigned to users or groups.
claims.quote: After you create or update new policies, assign them to users or groups.

claims.claim: People invited to a meeting have permissions to its recording.
claims.quote: People invited to the meeting have permissions to the recording (guests and external attendees can view the recording only if the recording is explicitly shared with them).
claims.fix: Add the source's qualification: 'People invited to a meeting have permissions to its recording; guests and external attendees can view it only if the recording is explicitly shared with them.' Keep the following Copilot Chat test recommendation.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no new identity, connection or permission specific to video recap.
claims.quote: Searched: video recap Copilot Chat identity permissions recording access retention eDiscovery. Read intelligent-recap-calls-meetings, manage-meeting-recaps-app and searched microsoft-365-copilot-privacy; no identity, connection or permission introduced specifically for video recap.

claims.claim: Microsoft warns that AI-generated audio recaps might contain inaccuracies.
claims.quote: Audio recaps, including voices, are AI-generated and might contain inaccuracies or audio glitches.

claims.claim: People who can access the recording may see clips of it through Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy for the general permission boundary. Keep the explicit test recommendation and the open question about the exact Copilot Chat video recap access experience.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether AllowIntelligentRecap also removes video recap from Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Searched: video recap disable setting Teams Copilot Chat PowerShell Microsoft Graph policy; "video recap" "Copilot Chat". Read intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; both describe meetings and Teams, not the Copilot Chat video recap surface.
